gold_author: Codex synthetic project-topic annotations, not human gold
gold_rule: All case-study/README chunks for the named topic, across all industries; CV and prior proposal chunks are distractors. No industry is specified by these jobs.
query: Original matcher query: title + newline + description, truncated to 4000
depth: Recall@5 from k=5; nDCG@10 from k=10. Original generation used k=5.
limits: Retrospective retrieval replay on the same jobs and source corpus; not a new generation experiment. Topic-family gold can contain more than five relevant source chunks, so Recall@5 need not approach one.
